texts.preamble: K.K.R. Food Products vs The Chief Secretary, The State Of Kerala on 9 July, 2025 Wa No.2495/2015, Co No.210/2015 1 2025:Ker:50843 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr.Justice Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari & The Honourable Mr. Justice Syam Kumar V.M. Wednesday, The 9Th Day Of July 2025 / 18Th Ashadha, 1947 Wa No. 2495 Of 2015 Against The Order/Judgment Dated 13.10.2015 In Wpc No.30005 Of 2015 Of High Court Of Kerala Appellants: 1 The Chief Secretary, The State Of Kerala Secretariat, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 001, Represented By The Advocate General, High Court Of Keala, Ernakulam - 682 030. 2 The Secretary Helath Department Of Health & Family Welfar,E Government Of Kerala, Secretariat Building, Thiruvananthapuram, Represented By The Advocate General, High Court Of Kerala, Ernakulam - 682 030.
texts.arguments: Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the appellants submitted that during pendency of the appeal, the respondent's proprietorship concern has been sold to someone else and he is operating the firm. He further pointed out that the learned Single Judge in point no.ii, paragraph ii.e. has granted the following liberty. 3. He contends that the ownership of the respondent firm already stood transferred and in view of the liberty and also due to efflux of time, no action is required to be taken against the respondent at present.
texts.petitioner_arguments: Learned Senior Counsel appearing for the appellants submitted that during pendency of the appeal, the respondent's proprietorship concern has been sold to someone else and he is operating the firm. He further pointed out that the learned Single Judge in point no.ii, paragraph ii.e. has granted the following liberty. 3. He contends that the ownership of the respondent firm already stood transferred and in view of the liberty and also due to efflux of time, no action is required to be taken against the respondent at present.
